criteria.source_section: Materials and methods: In silico search for putative GSH
criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

limitations: Only the publication-derived shortlist is investigated.
GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a newly sequenced H1 genome.
Control overlap and proximity cannot establish biological safety or causality.

Now I have all three tool results. Let me synthesize.

Key findings:
- Targeted DE: 96 qualifying rows, 96 unique versioned genes, 48 up / 48 down.
- Independent untargeted control DE: 260 qualifying, 194 up / 66 down.
- Count difference targeted minus control: -164.
- Overlap: shared 31, targeted-only 65, control-only 229, union 325. shared_fraction_of_targeted 31/96 = 0.3229; shared_fraction_of_control 31/260 = 0.1192; Jaccard 31/325 = 0.0954. All 31 shared same direction, 0 opposite.
- qPCR: MAGI3 +0.053, TXNL1 -0.046, ZNRF4 -0.012 (means log2FC), 5 replicates.
- Proximity: 96 DE genes, 40 mapped to GENCODE v36, 4 on same chromosome (chr1), 56 unmapped. Nearest DE genes on chr1: SYT11 gap 42,519,052 / nearest base 42,519,053; LMX1A 51,861,352/51,861,353; RHBDL2 74,398,130/74,398,131; CASP9 97,813,426/97,813,427. No overlap.
- Source-table nearest DE genes (Ensembl one-based, separate): ENSG00000237349 gap 4,352,715 / 4,352,716; ENSG00000277702 30,079,110/30,079,111; ENSG00000271618 41,601,606/41,601,607.

Note: the criteria require annotation-based distances (gene body, TSS, miRNA, lncRNA) — but the gene_proximity tool only returned DE-gene proximity, not the criteria distances to GENCODE v36 transcripts/TSS/miRNA/lncRNA. So the criteria (outside_gene_body, tss_distance, mirna_distance, lncrna_distance) remain incomplete — no tool computed those. Also cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer, outside_ultraconserved_regions unavailable.

So aggregate: incomplete.

The question: "Do these measured expression changes justify excluding this candidate region?" Answer: No — the evidence does not justify exclusion; and it also doesn't establish safety. The targeted changes are not distinguishable in kind from untargeted control variation (control has more DE genes, 260 vs 96; 31 shared same-direction). Proximity: nearest mapped DE gene is >42 Mb away, so no local cis DE gene among mapped ones; but 56/96 unmapped, and criteria distances not computed.

Important: the candidate region itself — is it within a gene body? Not computed. The criteria distances to GENCODE v36 TSS/miRNA/lncRNA not computed. So incomplete.

Numerical findings should include the key numbers. Evidence IDs: source:supp1, source:supp5:pansio-1, source:supp5:untargeted, source:gencode-v36:pansio-1, source:reference:pansio-1, source:supp4. Also artifact IDs.

Let me be careful: don't quote paper's interpretive conclusion. Don't assign global safe label. Keep gene-body and TSS distances distinct — but neither was computed, so note as unresolved.

Conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding the candidate region; the targeted DE set is smaller than the independent untargeted control DE set and shares 31 same-direction genes, so the changes are not separable from untargeted variation by these counts. Proximity: no mapped DE gene within 42.5 Mb. But criteria-based annotation distances (gene body, TSS, miRNA, lncRNA) and three unavailable tracks remain incomplete, so no exclusion and no safety determination.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing.

criteria.source_section: Materials and methods: In silico search for putative GSH
criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Identify H1 targeted-versus-control and untargeted-control contrasts, significance/selection rules, gene units, duplicate identifiers, and whether only significant results are tabulated. H9 is a different biological context.

Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established.
